area: Printer Friendly Work Orders - Audit Trail
title: Printing logs a Work Order Printed event in audit history
permissions_required: View Work Order (no new permission introduced)
preconditions: In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order (click its row) to reach its detail view. You have permission to view it. (Route drafted from the spec and marked PROVISIONAL — confirm the exact toolbar/labels on the build.)
The open work order has at least one line item on its Lines tab.
steps: Open the work order's audit history.
expected:
1. A “Work Order Printed” event is logged in the work order's audit history.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9383 and story SV-9389 (Story 6, Audit Trail) and the Printer Friendly Work Orders specification version 8, section S6-R1, read on 25 August 2026.
